rules.statement: A verbal transaction of sale is not a 'bill of sale' within the meaning of the Registration of Documents Ordinance, and thus does not require registration.
rules.supporting_quote: "This proposition seeks to extend the doctrine laid down by a Bench of two Judges in Indian Bank v. Chartered Bank et al.4[(1941) 43 N. L. R. 49.] to verbal contracts of purchase and sale. To my mind the proposition is unsound."
